cd C:\microprocessorassignment_2\build
ninja -j4 assign02

// ============================================================
//  GIT - useful commands
// ============================================================
git config --global --list                  
git add .                                   
git push origin main                        

// Stage specific files
cd C:\microprocessorassignment_2
git add assign02/assign02.c
git add assign02/assign02.S
git add assign02/welcome.c
git add assign02/welcome.h
git add assign02/game.c
git add assign02/game.h
git add assign02/CMakeLists.txt
git add assign02/git-notes.txt
git commit -m "message"
git push origin main                           

cd C:\Users\shipr\pico-apps
git add assignments/MICROPROCESSORASSIGNMENT_2/MICROPROCESSORASSIGNMENT_2.S
git add assignments/MICROPROCESSORASSIGNMENT_2/assi.c
git add assignments/MICROPROCESSORASSIGNMENT_2/CMakeLists.txt
git add assignments/MICROPROCESSORASSIGNMENT_2/ws2812.pio
git add assignments/MICROPROCESSORASSIGNMENT_2/git-notes.txt
git commit -m "Assignment2 working version. yaya"
git push origin main

// ============================================================
//  REBUILD FROM SCRATCH
// ============================================================
cd C:\microprocessorassignment_2
Remove-Item -Recurse -Force build
mkdir build
cd build
cmake .. -G Ninja -DPICO_SDK_PATH=C:/microprocessorassignment_2/pico-sdk
ninja -j4 assign02

// ============================================================
//  KILL LOCKED PROCESSES
// ============================================================
taskkill /F /IM Code.exe
taskkill /F /IM ninja.exe
taskkill /F /IM cmake.exe
taskkill /F /IM arm-none-eabi-gcc.exe
taskkill /F /IM openocd.exe
taskkill /F /IM gdb.exe

// Kill and clean build in one go
Remove-Item -Recurse -Force C:\Users\shipr\pico-apps\build
taskkill /F /IM Code.exe; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force C:\Users\shipr\pico-apps\build

rm -rf build
mkdir build
cd build
cmake ..
make

// ============================================================
//  FLASH - copy .uf2 to Pico (replace E:\ with your drive)
// ============================================================
copy C:\microprocessorassignment_2\build\assign02\assign02.uf2 E:\

// ============================================================
//  IF BUILD FOLDER GETS LOCKED
// ============================================================
Get-Process | Where-Object {$_.Modules.FileName -like "*assign02*"}
tasklist /v | findstr "assign02"
